name: wavelens
description: VCD and FST dumps in a tab: the WaveLens viewer with assertions, bus transactions and the agent's live link; works over Remote-SSH / WSL with nothing installed on the host

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension runs the bundled sva program on the dumps of the workspace.

commands.title: Choose the theme of the waves
Make the types with Verilator (FSM states, structs)
Convert to FST (beside the VCD, FSM states kept)

wavelens.verilator.markdownDescription: The Verilator 5 of *WaveLens: Make the types with Verilator* (`verilator --json-only`: nothing is built). On the host of the extension (Remote - WSL / SSH: there).

wavelens.keysToVSCode.markdownDescription: Keys of the viewer left to VS Code in the tab (`ctrl+G`: Go to Line; the viewer's list of your groups is `gl` then). The viewer's other keys are the plain ones (`?` lists them) and `ctrl+F` / `ctrl+C` / `ctrl+Z` / `alt+C W R`, which mean there what they mean in VS Code. `ctrl+` is `cmd+` on a Mac.

wavelens.autoReload.description: When the dump changes on the disk (a new simulation), read it again at once, the view kept. Off: the tab says so and ⟳ reads it.

wavelens.live.description: Connect the open tabs to an agent's tools/wavemcp.py of this user when it starts its live link (view_live), and let it open dumps here.

enumDescriptions: The viewer's light or dark by the kind of VS Code's theme
The colours of VS Code's theme: its background, text, lines and accent (the traces' colours by its kind)
The viewer's light: grey paper that does not glare
Pure white, black traces: for print and slides
wavelens.theme.description: The theme of the waves (WaveLens: Choose the theme of the waves shows each on the open tabs).

wavelens.sources.description: SystemVerilog sources of the workspace (globs) whose typedef enum names label the state buses of a VCD (a VCD has none: Questa writes none) and whose typedef struct packed splits a vector into fields; matched by the variable's name. Not used when the dump has its types beside it (tb.types.json by tb.vcd: by path). Empty: none.

wavelens.sva.description: The sva program that turns an FST into VCD text (empty: the one inside the extension).
